sn45.133:1.1: “Bhikkhus, the Ganges river slants, slopes, and inclines to the ocean.
sn45.133:1.2: In the same way, a bhikkhu who develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.
sn45.133:1.3: And how does a bhikkhu who develops the noble eightfold path slant, slope, and incline to extinguishment?
sn45.133:1.4: It’s when a bhikkhu develops right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration, which slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.
sn45.133:1.5: That’s how a bhikkhu who develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.”
